messages:
Maria (CSM): FYI ClearLeaf just dropped ~75% MAU after their champion left. Procurement just asked for competitor pricing this morning. Renewal ~5w out. Need quick risk plan. Dashboard: https://rbw.infer/cleaf/activity

Leo (AE): Noted. Do we have signal whether it's a product change (client) or adoption falloff?

Sam (SRE): Quick check  API success rate steady, p50 latency unchanged. Looks like client-side call reduction. I'll pull per-endpoint counts.

Maria (CSM): Their PM mentioned turning off background embedding for cost reasons. That was powering two core features.

Anna (RevOps): If we offer credits, we need a rev impact calc. How big is the ARR here?

Leo (AE): They're ~$180k ARR. Worth a short-term promo to avoid churn. Can we do 30% credits for 8 weeks? Need legal for terms.

Jamie (Sales): Also recommend a 30m enablement for new internal champion + a hands-on tuning session (prompt prompts + cache windows).

Sam (SRE): Draft recovery checklist I can share: 1) re-enable background embeds (or sampled prefetch), 2) increase client batch_size from 4->12, 3) enable prefix cache TTL 24h. Example config diff:
```
# client config
batch_size: 4 -> 12
embed_prefetch: false -> sampled(0.3)
cache_ttl_seconds: 0 -> 86400
```

Maria (CSM): That looks good. I'll schedule a 30m call with PM + eng this week. Jamie, can you prepare a short competitive counter-offer (pricing + 8-week credits)?

Jamie (Sales): On it. Also prepping a one-pager on ROI impact of re-enabling embeds. Small screenshots + token cost table.

Anna (RevOps): If we approve credits, tie them to a success metric (recovery to >=80% of prior MAU within 6 weeks). Otherwise we risk abuse.

Maria (CSM): Agreed. Define KPI and attach to extension SOW. Sam, can you set a simple metric check that pings this channel when MAU recovers to threshold?

Sam (SRE): I'll add an alert: if daily active embed calls >= 0.8 * baseline for 7d, OpsBot will post.

OpsBot: Renewal reminder  ClearLeaf renewal due 2026-05-01 (5w).

Leo (AE): Flagging as high touch. I'll get legal looped and share draft promo. If procurement shares competitor price, paste here so we can respond quickly.

Maria (CSM): Thanks team. I'll send invite + agenda now. We'll aim to close a recovery plan before next week. :hands_together:
